messages:
olivia: Quick PSA — final reminder to add your release note bullets for 0.18.3 by EOD tomorrow. We're gating the release on entries in KEEP-CHANGELOG.
jamie: Where's the template again? I have one small tweak on telemetry names.
olivia: Paste template below — keep one short sentence + component tag.
olivia: ```- component(cli): reduce memory usage when loading model cache (internal)
- component(serve): fallback to cpu for small batches (user-impact)
```
jamie: Thanks — should I put it in the PR description or the release-notes/ dir?
sara: prefer PR desc + add `changelog` label. Release tooling will pick it up from PR body. :white_check_mark:
devin: pinging owners for backports: @alex, @mike — does the v0.18 branch need your approval for the quantize fix?
alex: I reviewed the PR, it's fine. I'll land the backport tonight and add the changelog bullet.
mike: FYI I updated the branch protection rules so only squash merges allowed on release branches.
release-bot: Reminder: changelog cutoff in 36h (2026-03-19 17:00 UTC). If you need an exception, ping #eng-releases with a short rationale.
luis: small nit — please use `component(serve)` not `component(runtime)` for routing changes.
olivia: noted. I'll do a quick sweep tomorrow morning and nudge any missing owners. If you haven't added your line by 17:00 UTC, I'll add one with "author: team" and minimal wording. :pray:
jamie: copied. adding now.
sara: I'll run the release script after cutoff and post the release notes draft here.
olivia: thanks everyone — keep these compact. DM me if blocked.
